name: Lucky Rabbit Club
summary:
"How could you lose that? Don't you know how important it is?"

The Lucky Rabbit—a nightclub as famous as it is infamous, and named after its very owner. Drinking, drugs, dancing, all the stuff that makes the night life enticing and fills you with regret in the morning. Nina has regrets—but not over having a fun night. Rather, she regrets being so careless with one of her belongings. On her search to find it again, she returns to The Lucky Rabbit and the charmed owner himself. Another night of fun awaits her—but not for her.

Lucky Rabbit Club is a murdersim-styled visual novel with many point-and-click puzzle/adventure sections.
The game takes about 2 hours to complete. There are 11 endings, including a True Ending, and an unlockable Bonus Scene that will follow the True Ending. The game features an endings menu to help you keep track.
